boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named SLU spaces for studying, meeting, movement, reflection, and campus activity, each supported by a current university source.

cards.title: Joseph G. Lipic Clock Tower
cards.subtitle: West Pine Mall
cards.notes: Use the plaza as a clear meetup point, then take a seat by the fountain or amphitheater before heading to the next campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor plaza with stairs, fountains, and room to meet between activities.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes the Clock Tower at the center of West Pine Mall as a popular campus meeting spot and site for outdoor fairs and activities.
cards.source_title: Live Stream: Saint Louis University Clock Tower
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; check campus event scheduling for programmed use.

cards.title: Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: North Campus library
cards.notes: Bring a partner or reserve a room through the library system; unreserved rooms can be used until the confirmed group arrives.
cards.short_summary: Library study rooms support both solo work and group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Pius Library has reservable single and collaborative study rooms, and its policy allows use without a reservation until the confirmed group needs the room.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are limited to current SLU students, faculty, and staff; observe room occupancy and reservation priority.

cards.title: Academic Technology Commons
cards.subtitle: Inside Pius XII Memorial Library
cards.notes: Set up a project session here when you need computers, quick printing, charging, or flexible seating rather than a silent reading room.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped library workspace for individual and group project work.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU says the Academic Technology Commons provides modular work areas, computer workstations, charging, and quick-print stations for individual and group work.
cards.access_notes: Located in Pius Library; equipment and service availability may vary.

cards.title: Busch Student Center
cards.subtitle: 20 N. Grand Blvd.
cards.notes: Use the building as a practical rendezvous for an organization meeting, campus errand, or meal break, and consult the posted building hours.
cards.short_summary: SLU's central student hub combines gathering space, services, organizations, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU identifies the Busch Student Center as a central campus hub and gathering place with student-development offices, student organizations, dining, and meeting spaces.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours listed by SLU are 7 a.m.–12 a.m.; confirm changes before visiting.

cards.title: Shanahan Atrium
cards.subtitle: John and Lucy Cook Hall
cards.notes: Choose a table or lounge chair for a low-key work session, and shift plans if a scheduled event is using the atrium.
cards.short_summary: An open Cook Hall atrium built for meeting, studying, relaxing, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU says Shanahan Atrium has tables, leather furniture, wireless access, and uses including meeting, studying, relaxing, and special events.
cards.access_notes: Located in Cook Hall; special events may affect available seating.

cards.title: The Quad
cards.subtitle: North Campus green space
cards.notes: Pack a blanket or use the lawn for a daytime reading break, a casual game, or a walk between buildings when weather permits.
cards.short_summary: A campus lawn used for informal study, slacklining, and pickup recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU's campus-tour page describes the Quad as a favorite place for studying, slacklining, and a quick game of Frisbee.
cards.source_title: See Campus: Virtual Tours and More
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use is weather-dependent and may be affected by campus programming.

cards.title: Samuel Cupples House
cards.subtitle: West Pine Mall
cards.notes: Pause outside to take in the historic façade and photograph it from West Pine Mall; check museum information before planning an interior visit.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus house and museum that remains a visual landmark on West Pine Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU identifies the Historic Samuel Cupples House as a former student union that is now a museum and a campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Exterior is on West Pine Mall; verify museum access and exhibition availability separately.

cards.title: Center for Global Citizenship
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Meet on the second floor for seated work, or arrange access to an AT&T Commons study cube when your group needs a defined workspace.
cards.short_summary: A campus center with seating and reservable study options for individual and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU's study-spaces guide notes second-floor Caffe seating and reservable study cubes in the Center for Global Citizenship's AT&T Commons.
cards.source_title: 8 (+1) Places to Study for Finals at SLU
cards.access_notes: Study-cube reservations require contacting Event Services; food and drink purchases are optional.

cards.title: St. Francis Xavier College Church
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Visit respectfully for quiet reflection or attend the weekly student Mass; confirm service times and any event-related access before you go.
cards.short_summary: SLU's campus church hosts weekly student Mass and serves as a reflective landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU's campus-tour page identifies St. Francis Xavier College Church as the location of a weekly student Mass.
cards.source_title: See Campus: Virtual Tours and More
cards.access_notes: Religious services and events can affect interior access; follow posted church guidance.

cards.title: Simon Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Heart of North Campus
cards.notes: Bring your SLU ID and choose a drop-in activity, workout, swim, or court session; consult the facility page for current building hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility with courts, fitness areas, pool, track, and bouldering wall.
cards.evidence_claim: SLU describes Simon Recreation Center as a 120,000-square-foot campus fitness and wellness hub with a pool, courts, bouldering wall, fitness center, indoor track, and lounge areas.
cards.access_notes: SLU students are automatic members and must present identification; hours and access policies vary by facility area.
